issue_request: FHIR-15809 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Procedure after an STU3 Patient Care vote. It requested adding search parameters for Procedure reasonCode and reasonReference so Procedure could be searched by associated condition, symptom, or diagnosis.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92 explicitly applied GF#15809 and added reason-code and reason-reference rows to the old Procedure spreadsheet over Procedure.reasonCode and Procedure.reasonReference. Later source refactors carried those definitions into the current bundled search-parameter source.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current R5/R6 Procedure model merges the old reasonCode/reasonReference split into Procedure.reason, with concept and reference parts; source/fhir.ini records that migration, and the current search parameters use Procedure.reason.concept and Procedure.reason.reference. Related Procedure reason guidance issues FHIR-13974 and FHIR-16346 concern usage clarification rather than the search-parameter request.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source change is needed: source/procedure/bundle-Procedure-search-params.xml already defines reason-code and reason-reference for Procedure in current build scope.
